question: MSME stands for small and ___________ enterprises.
solution:
The correct answer is __**medium-sized **__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **MSME:-**

 
 
• **It stands for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises. **
 
• It is a sector of the Indian economy that consists of enterprises engaged in the production, manufacturing, processing or preservation of goods and services, whose investment in plant and machinery or equipment does not exceed the limit specified for the sector.
 
• The MSME sector is classified into three categories based on their investment in plant and machinery or equipment:
 
 
• **Micro:** Investment up to INR 25 lakh
 
• **Small**: Investment between INR 25 lakh and INR 10 crore
 
• **Medium**: Investment between INR 10 crore and INR 50 crore
 
 
 
• The MSME sector plays a vital role in the Indian economy.** It contributes around 45% of India's GDP and employs over 11 crore people. The sector is also responsible for over 40% of India's exports.**
 
• The Government of India has implemented a number of schemes and initiatives to support the MSME sector. These include:
 
 
• **Udyam Registration:** A free and online registration process for MSMEs to get a unique identification number (Udyam Registration Number).
 
• **Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)**: Provides credit guarantees to MSMEs to help them access loans from banks and financial institutions.
 
• **Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP):** A self-employment scheme for educated unemployed youth to set up micro-enterprises.
 
• **MSME Development Institutes (MSMEDIs): **Provide various training and support services to MSMEs.
